quote_original: Christ is your life which is wholly supernatural.
context_before: Take this wonderful story to heart. It is a true one.
context_after: The birth is supernatural. The discovery of the Father is supernatural. No physical dove descends upon your shoulder – it is a supernatural experience, but this fantastic truth has been embodied in a tale that man could understand; for, as Tennyson said: “Truth embodied in a tale shall enter in at lowly doors.”
